rows.en:
(Homemade chocolate from Pinon-chan...
I'd better savor every bite.)

(I bought chocolate for Saotome-kun, since we
always get along so well, but now that it's time
to give it to him, I'm nervous after all...)

(I wanted to give Saotome-kun the chocolate,
but the timing never worked out...)

Hey, \p.
What are you doing over there?
Huh, Saotome-kun?! You're still here?
What, is there a problem with that?

No, I was just looking for you.
Here, this chocolate's for you.
Yeah, I'm glad I managed to give it to you.
Then I'll have to pay you back on White Day.
Oh, you don't have to worry about that...

It'd feel wrong to just take it and give nothing.
Besides, it's to thank you for everything, too...
Wow, so you can be thoughtful like that, huh?
Tch, forget it! I'm not giving you anything back!
I was just kidding~

(Is Saotome-kun just a stickler for returning
favors... or...?)

(I feel bad for Saotome-kun, but it's too
embarrassing after all. I can't give him
the chocolate...)
rows.notes: The Japanese line lacks its opening bracket (source typo: only the closing one is there). Opening parenthesis added since it is clearly the player's inner monologue, as in the matching lines for the other boys.

rows.en:
(Hmm, I wanted to give Michel-kun the chocolate,
but the timing never worked out...)

Whoa, what are you doing in a place like this,
\p?

Huh? Oh, um, well...
I was hoping to give you some chocolate,
Michel-kun...

Well, what do you know.
I was bummed, thinking I wouldn't get any
from you, but you had some ready for me.

Sorry it's so late...
Here, Michel-kun.
This Valentine's chocolate is for you.

Thanks, \p.
I'll be sure to enjoy it later.

And I'll pay you back properly on White Day,
so look forward to it.

(It was a bit late, but I'm glad I managed
to give Michel-kun the chocolate. I wonder
what he'll give me back on White Day?)

(I wanted to give Luca-kun the chocolate,
but the timing never worked out...)
Luca-kun! I've been looking for you all over~

You were?
Is something wrong?

Here, Luca-kun. It's late, but
this is your Valentine's chocolate.

Oh, thank you very much.
I'll be sure to enjoy it later.

Oh, and I'll be sure to return the favor on
White Day, so look forward to it!

(It was a bit late, but I'm glad I managed
to give Luca-kun the chocolate. I wonder
what he'll give me back on White Day?)
Oh, \p-kun!

Here. I thought I'd give this to you,
\p-kun...
Huh? This is for me?
You always help me out, so I thought maybe...
Wow, thank you!

I gave it a Chinese-style twist, so I can't
promise how it'll taste, though.
rows.notes: Chuuka-fuu: Nanase works at the Chinese restaurant Nyan-Nyan.

rows.en: Ch-Chinese-style...
Well then, I'll be heading home.

(If she put her own twist on it, that means
it's homemade chocolate, right...?)

H-heeey!
\p-kun!

Huh, Ranka?
Weren't you working today?

...Yeah, but I got a little time off,
and there was something I wanted to give you.
Something for me?
Geez~ Today's Valentine's Day, isn't it?
Here! Take it!

Huh? Oh, th-thanks!
I hadn't gotten any from anyone,
so I'm really happy!!

So mine's the only one, huh?
That makes me kinda happy.

Well, I'd better get back!
That chocolate's homemade, by the way!!

(Homemade chocolate from Ranka...
I'd better savor every bite.)
Huh, Sheryl?

Why the gloomy face?
I know, you didn't get any chocolate!
Sh-shut up...
Oh, did I hit the nail on the head...? Sorry...
Nah, it's fine...

Oh, it can't be helped. Then I, Sheryl,
will give you some chocolate!
rows.notes: Kono Sheryl ga: Sheryl referring to herself by name.

rows.en:
Don't get the wrong idea. I'm only doing it
out of pity for you!

Don't mention it. But you owe me big for this,
so don't you forget it!

(It doesn't look great, but it's tasty...
Wait, is this homemade?)
H-hey! \p!

Oh, Klan-senpai!
What brings you to Mihoshi?
Do you need something?
...I have something to give you!

T-today's Valentine's Day, after all!
So I, in my great kindness, shall give
you some chocolate!
rows.notes: Kokoro yasashii watashi ga: Klan's grand self-description kept.

rows.en: Here! Take it!

Huh? Oh, th-thank you so much!
I hadn't gotten any from anyone,
so I'm really happy!

Listen, it's just obligation chocolate! Obligation!
Don't get any weird ideas.

Mm, good.
I-it's chocolate I made myself, so savor it well!
S-see you!

(Homemade chocolate from Klan-senpai...
I'd better savor every bite.)
